thread:
carol-support: Acme reporting repeated failures when calling billing tool via function call. Customer sees JSON schema validation errors, blocks checkout. Ticket #AC-9842. Error blob pasted below.

alice.k: paste of API error from logs:
```json
{"error":"schema_validation_failed","details":[{"path":"/billing","message":"required property 'billing_profile' is missing"},{"path":"/billing/line_items","message":"expected array but got string"},{"path":"/","message":"additionalProperties 'debug' not allowed"}]}
```

carol-support: They say payload comes from our JS SDK (v2.4.1) via toolcall -> billing. Customer provided their request body; note line_items is a string (they serialize earlier) and they added a debug flag for internal tracing.

ben_r: Can you paste the exact request? quick check: maybe SDK coercion changed?

carol-support: request they sent:
```json
{"customer_id":"acme-47","amount":1200,"billing":{"line_items":"[{\"sku\":\"basic\",\"qty\":1}]","currency":"USD"},"debug":true}
```

alice.k: OK repro notes: schema expects billing.line_items: array<object>, billing_profile required at /billing/billing_profile. customer omitted billing_profile entirely. Also additionalProperties false on root, so extra `debug` fails.

dave-eng: :eyes: This looks like two separate problems: 1) upstream client serializes line_items as string (so type mismatch) 2) they rely on permissive additionalProps previously allowed (debug) 3) missing required field billing_profile.

ben_r: Do we know whether SDK auto-stringified arrays in some older minor? If so clients may be sending that way. Which model of validation? JSON Schema draft-07 with additionalProperties=false for billing.

alice.k: Customer says they just upgraded our SDK last week. Ticket notes "checkout worked before, broke after upgrade". They provided previous request (pre-upgrade) where line_items was an array and included billing_profile.

carol-support: Customer needs a hotfix or a clear workaround asap. They are hitting production checkout; high priority. Can we suggest server-side lenient parsing as temporary mitigation?

dave-eng: Short-term workaround: support team can pre-validate and coerce line_items if it's a JSON-string. I can push a middleware in staging to coerce `billing.line_items` when type is string containing JSON array. But we need eng-ml or runtime to confirm safe.

ben_r: Also suggest telling customer to include billing_profile and stop sending debug meta in root. Provide sample tolerant payload we accept: ```json
{"customer_id":"acme-47","billing":{"billing_profile":"default","line_items":[{"sku":"basic","qty":1}],"currency":"USD"}}
```

alice.k: I'll send the sample and a short repro script to customer. Also creating internal repro with their exact payload on staging (ticket AC-9842).

carol-support: support-bot created support ticket AC-9842 and linked incident #INC-5123.

support-bot: Ticket AC-9842 created and assigned to support (carol-support). Priority: P1. Related: INC-5123.

dave-eng: I'm picking up the staging repro. If coercion looks safe I'll deploy a temporary middleware branch and we can roll it to production behind a feature flag.

ben_r: Long-term we should consider minimal schema-coercion rules or clearer SDK validation so client upgrades don't change serialization semantics silently. File a follow-up in eng-runtime backlog. :memo:

alice.k: Noted, filing RFC for SDK behavior + runtime validation policy. For now sending mitigation instructions to Acme.

carol-support: Thanks everyone — updating customer now with workaround and ETA for staged fix. :thumbsup:
